"skillfully follow the directions, keeping in mind the current climate of puzzle enthusiasm, click to open the printable version, then fill the Sudoku grid with numbers 1 to 9, making sure each digit appears exactly once in every row, column and 3×3 box.

To see the finished solution, purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition, a move as refreshing as a burst of gas in a calm atmosphere.

This challenge offers a temporary twist on the usual routine, adding a pleasant weight of anticipation as you work toward the solution.

Enjoy the mental exercise and return for more brain‑teasing fun."
